trechos: The agent works directly inside Google Workspace apps including Gmail, Docs, Sheets and Calendar, and can also be used through Microsoft 365 and Slack.
Users can create "coworker agents" that act as team members, with their own email address and access only to the information they are given.

itens.titulo: Micron's DRAM Sales Reach $40B: Can AI Demand Drive Growth?
itens.descricao: Micron's DRAM Sales Reach $40B: Can AI Demand Drive Growth? Yahoo! Finance Canada
trechos: The company's DRAM revenues reached a record $39.8 billion in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, accounting for 73% of the total revenues.
Sales skyrocketed 343% year over year and grew 27% sequentially, driven by strong pricing and rising demand.
Micron expects server unit growth in the high-teens percentage range in both 2026 and 2027, providing a favorable demand backdrop for its DRAM products.
It has also completed agreements covering most of its 2027 HBM bit supply, with significantly higher prices compared with the prior year.
Micron expects industry DRAM bit shipments to grow in the low-20% range in 2027 and 2028, while the market remains supply constrained.
The Zacks Consensus Estimate for Micron's fiscal 2027 DRAM revenues is pegged at $204.04 billion, indicating a 102.7% surge from the $100.68 billion reported in fiscal 2026.
In the second quarter of 2026, SK hynix generated 79.3 trillion Korean won in revenues, up 257% year over year, while operating profit surged 557% to 60.5 trillion won.
Its fiscal 2026 revenues jumped 175% to $20.25 billion, while data-center revenues soared 437% to $5.15 billion.

itens.titulo: Brisk $39 Billion Treasury Auction Offers Bond Market Breather
itens.descricao: Brisk $39 Billion Treasury Auction Offers Bond Market Breather Yahoo Finance
trechos: At first, the yield on the benchmark 10-year US Treasury note spiked to 5.36%, the highest level since 2002.
But then $39 billion in 10-year notes sold at a brisk afternoon Treasury auction, and the surge in demand helped bring the yield down to 5.282%, offering a breather from the bond bloodbath.
The 5.3% auction yield was the highest since 2000, but it also got the job done.
"That undercuts claims of a buyer shortage," he wrote.
"Yet only two sectors are positive: technology, up 7.1%, and communication services, up 3.3%.
Financials have fallen around 7%, materials 6.6%, utilities 6.2% and real estate 6.1%." - "That tells us something important: Higher bond yields are already hurting equities," she wrote.
"The pain is simply being masked by the strength of AI and megacap technology."
